text_en: There was a certain man of Ramathaim, a Zuphite from the hill country of Ephraim, whose name was Elkanah son of Jeroham son of Elihu son of Tohu son of Zuph, an Ephraimite.
text_cn: 从前在辣玛有个厄弗辣因山地的族弗人，名叫厄耳卡纳，是耶洛罕的儿子，——耶洛罕是厄里胡的儿子，厄里胡是托胡的儿子，托胡是厄弗辣因人族弗的儿子。 ──

text_en: He had two wives; the name of the one was Hannah, and the name of the other Peninnah. Peninnah had children, but Hannah had no children.
text_cn: 他有两个妻子：一个名叫亚纳，一个名叫培尼纳；培尼纳有孩子，亚纳却没有。

text_en: Now this man used to go up year by year from his town to worship and to sacrifice to the Lord of hosts at Shiloh, where the two sons of Eli, Hophni and Phinehas, were priests of the Lord .
text_cn: 这人每年从本城上史罗去朝拜祭献万军的上主。那里有厄里的两个儿子曷弗尼和丕乃哈斯做上主的司祭。

text_en: On the day when Elkanah sacrificed, he would give portions to his wife Peninnah and to all her sons and daughters;
text_cn: 有一天，厄耳卡纳献祭后，就把祭品给了自己的妻子培尼纳和她的儿女好几分，

text_en: but to Hannah he gave a double portion, because he loved her, though the Lord had closed her womb.
text_cn: 只给了亚纳一分；他虽喜爱亚纳，无奈上主封闭了她的子宫；

text_en: Her rival used to provoke her severely, to irritate her, because the Lord had closed her womb.
text_cn: 就因上主封闭了亚纳的子宫，她的情敌便羞辱刺激她，使她愤怒。

text_en: So it went on year by year; as often as she went up to the house of the Lord , she used to provoke her. Therefore Hannah wept and would not eat.
text_cn: 年年都是这样：每次她上上主的圣殿时，总是这样刺激亚纳。──亚纳伤心痛哭，不肯吃饭。

text_en: Her husband Elkanah said to her, “Hannah, why do you weep? Why do you not eat? Why is your heart sad? Am I not more to you than ten sons? ”
text_cn: 她的丈夫厄耳卡纳对她说：“亚纳，你为什么哭，不肯用饭？为什么伤心？难道我对你不比十个儿子还好吗？”

text_en: After they had eaten and drunk at Shiloh, Hannah rose and presented herself before the Lord . Now Eli the priest was sitting on the seat beside the doorpost of the temple of the Lord .
text_cn: 在史罗吃喝完了，亚纳就起来走到上主面前；那时司祭厄里正对着上主圣殿门口，坐在椅子上。

text_en: She was deeply distressed and prayed to the Lord , and wept bitterly.
text_cn: 她心灵愁苦，哀求上主，不断痛哭流泪；

text_en: She made this vow: “O Lord of hosts, if only you will look on the misery of your servant, and remember me, and not forget your servant, but will give to your servant a male child, then I will set him before you as a nazirite until the day of his death. He shall drink neither wine nor intoxicants, and no razor shall touch his head. ”
text_cn: 且许愿说：“万军的上主，若你垂顾你婢女的痛苦，记念我，不忘你的婢女，赐你婢女生一个男孩，我就将他一生献于上主，一辈子不给他剃头。”

text_en: As she continued praying before the Lord , Eli observed her mouth.
text_cn: 亚纳在上主面前祈祷很久，厄里曾注意到她的嘴唇；

text_en: Hannah was praying silently; only her lips moved, but her voice was not heard; therefore Eli thought she was drunk.
text_cn: 亚纳只是心内诉说，嘴唇微动，却听不到她的声音，厄里却以为她喝醉了，

text_en: So Eli said to her, “How long will you make a drunken spectacle of yourself? Put away your wine. ”
text_cn: 就对她说：“你要醉到几时？消消你身上的酒气吧！”

text_en: But Hannah answered, “No, my lord, I am a woman deeply troubled; I have drunk neither wine nor strong drink, but I have been pouring out my soul before the Lord .
text_cn: 亚纳答说：“我主！你想错了；我是个遭遇不幸的女人，清酒烈酒总不沾唇；我是在上主面前倾吐我的心意。

text_en: Do not regard your servant as a worthless woman, for I have been speaking out of my great anxiety and vexation all this time. ”
text_cn: 望你不要以为你的婢女是个坏人，因为我由于极度的痛苦悲伤，才一直倾诉到现在。”

text_en: Then Eli answered, “Go in peace; the God of Israel grant the petition you have made to him. ”
text_cn: 厄里回答她说：“你平安去吧！愿以色列的天主赐给你求他的事。”

text_en: And she said, “Let your servant find favor in your sight. ” Then the woman went to her quarters, ate and drank with her husband, and her countenance was sad no longer.
text_cn: 她答说：“愿你的婢女在你眼内蒙恩。” 这女人就回了旅舍，吃完饭，不再愁容满面。

text_en: They rose early in the morning and worshiped before the Lord ; then they went back to their house at Ramah. Elkanah knew his wife Hannah, and the Lord remembered her.
text_cn: 次日清早，他们起来，朝拜了上主，就回了辣玛本家。厄耳卡纳认识了妻子亚纳，上主也记念了她，

text_en: In due time Hannah conceived and bore a son. She named him Samuel, for she said, “I have asked him of the Lord . ”
text_cn: 亚纳就怀了孕，生了一个儿子，给他起名叫撒慕尔，说：“因为是我向上主求得了他。” 约过了一年，

text_en: The man Elkanah and all his household went up to offer to the Lord the yearly sacrifice, and to pay his vow.
text_cn: 她的丈夫厄耳卡纳和全家上史罗去，向上主奉献年祭，并还所许的愿，

text_en: But Hannah did not go up, for she said to her husband, “As soon as the child is weaned, I will bring him, that he may appear in the presence of the Lord , and remain there forever; I will offer him as a nazirite for all time. ”
text_cn: 亚纳却没有上去，因她对丈夫说：“等孩子断了乳，我要带他去，将他奉献给上主，以后他永住在那里。”

text_en: Her husband Elkanah said to her, “Do what seems best to you, wait until you have weaned him; only—may the Lord establish his word. ” So the woman remained and nursed her son, until she weaned him.
text_cn: 她的丈夫厄耳卡纳对她说：“就照你的意思办吧！等他断了乳再说；惟愿上主实现你的话！”于是他的妻子留在家里，乳养孩子，直到断了乳。

text_en: When she had weaned him, she took him up with her, along with a three-year-old bull, an ephah of flour, and a skin of wine. She brought him to the house of the Lord at Shiloh; and the child was young.
text_cn: 断乳后，她便带着小孩和一头三岁的牛，一‘厄法’面和一皮囊酒，来到史罗上主的圣殿；孩子还很小。

text_en: Then they slaughtered the bull, and they brought the child to Eli.
text_cn: 他们祭杀了牛以后，孩子的母亲来到厄里前，

text_en: And she said, “Oh, my lord! As you live, my lord, I am the woman who was standing here in your presence, praying to the Lord .
text_cn: 对他说：“我主，请听：我主，就如你活着那样真实，我就是曾在你旁边祈求上主的那个妇人，

text_en: For this child I prayed; and the Lord has granted me the petition that I made to him.
text_cn: 那时我为得到这孩子祈祷，上主就赏赐了我所恳求的，

text_en: Therefore I have lent him to the Lord ; as long as he lives, he is given to the Lord . ” She left him there for the Lord .
text_cn: 所以我现在把他献于上主，他一生是属于上主的。” 亚纳便把他留在上主那里。
